newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW says Q1 97 group sales 13.983 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: BMW says Q1 97 group sales 13.983 bln DM.

text.p: German car maker BMW AG said on Tuesday group sales in the first quarter of 1997 rose 21.6 percent to 13.983 billion marks.

Auto production rose 11.8 percent to 316,324 vehicles. That included a 15.3 percent rise in the BMW group to 175,627, and a 7.7 percent increase in its Rover group to 140,697, the company said in a statement.
The company also said auto deliveries for the January to March period rose 8.2 percent to 289.800, with BMW's share climbing 13.6 percent to 164,656 and Rover's increasing 1.8 percent to 125,144.
